title: Cartan--Eilenberg Leray construction and bottom cocycle computation
statement: For a continuous map f:Z -> X with additive direct image, let HX and HZ be terminal-open abelian-sheaf cohomology functors with the specified equalities [def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology]. Let KX and KZ be the sheafifications of the free abelian representables of the terminal opens. Let a:KX -> f_*KZ have the displayed inverse-image generator formula. There exists a first-quadrant cohomological spectral sequence E in the category of functors from abelian sheaves on Z to abelian groups. Its second-page comparisons are e2_(p,q):E2^(p,q) -> R^q f_* followed by HX^p, each an isomorphism. For each p,q its entries stabilize to Einfinity^(p,q), read at page p+q+2: some integer R>=2 has E_r^(p,q) isomorphic to this entry for every r>=R. There is a decreasing filtration T of HZ [def-sp-filtration] with T^0 HZ^n=top and T^(n+1) HZ^n=bottom, and graded comparisons g_(p,q):T^p HZ^(p+q)/T^(p+1) HZ^(p+q) -> Einfinity^(p,q). There are isomorphisms e0_p:f_* followed by HX^p -> E2^(p,0), whose forward maps are the right-derived-zero transformation of f_* whiskered by HX^p followed by e2_(p,0)^(-1). There are transitions t_(p,r):E_r^(p,0) -> E_(r+1)^(p,0) for r>=2 such that iCycles followed by t equals homology projection followed by the next-page comparison. Their iterates b_(p,r):E2^(p,0) -> E_r^(p,0) satisfy b_(p,2)=id and b_(p,r+1)=b_(p,r) followed by t_(p,r). There are isomorphisms k_p:Einfinity^(p,0) -> T^p HZ^p such that the cokernel projection from T^p HZ^p followed by g_(p,0) equals k_p^(-1). There is a natural bottom map equal to e0 followed by b_(p+2), k and the filtration inclusion. For any sheaf F, resolutions I of F and J of f_*F, comparison phi:J -> f_*I over f_*F, and cocycles s:KX -> J^p and z:KZ -> I^p with a followed by f_*z equal to s followed by phi^p, this bottom map sends J.extMk(s) to I.extMk(z), after transport by hX and hZ. No prescribed cohomology map or characterization of one is an input or a conclusion.

proof.text: Obtain the topological spectral object Y with h,e and its bottom augmentation computation. Set E to the existing standard natural-number spectral sequence of Y and e2 to the canonical page-two comparison followed by e.

Prove bottom outgoing differentials vanish using the natural-number spectral-sequence complex shape. Invert cycles inclusion, then compose with homology projection and the successor-page comparison to form t. Define b by Int.leInduction from the identity and prove both recursion identities. For stabilization, apply the spectral-object page comparison at arbitrary r>=p+q+2, replace its outer interval endpoints by bottom and top using first-quadrant vanishing, and compose with the inverse comparison at pageInfinity.

Construct T explicitly as the transported imageFiltration(n,n+1-i); its antitonicity follows from imageFiltration_mono. First-quadrant vanishing gives step zero=top and step n+1=bottom. Apply the graded bottom-filtration comparison to obtain g,k and the factorization of the spectral-object bottom edge through b and k.

Define e0 from the whiskered derived-zero isomorphism and e2 inverse. Define bottom using the derived-zero map, e inverse, spectral-object bottomEdge and h. Rewrite the generic bottom factorization and cancel the canonical page-two isomorphism with its inverse; this proves the required filtration composite. The augmentation computation proves the cocycle equation for this explicit bottom.

theorem exists_topological_leray_cartan_eilenberg_cocycle
    {Z X : TopCat.{u}} (f : Z ⟶ X) [(TopCat.Sheaf.pushforwardAb f).Additive]
    (HX : ℕ → (Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u} ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u}))
    (HZ : ℕ → (Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology Z) AddCommGrpCat.{u} ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u}))
    (hX : ∀ n, HX n = Sheaf.cohomologyPresheafFunctor (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) n ⋙
      (evaluation (Opens X)ᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj (op ⊤))
    (hZ : ∀ n, HZ n = Sheaf.cohomologyPresheafFunctor (Opens.grothendieckTopology Z) n ⋙
      (evaluation (Opens Z)ᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj (op ⊤))
    (a : (presheafToSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
        AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
        (yoneda.obj (⊤ : Opens X) ⋙ AddCommGrpCat.free) ⟶
      (TopCat.Sheaf.pushforwardAb f).obj
        ((presheafToSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology Z)
          AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
          (yoneda.obj (⊤ : Opens Z) ⋙ AddCommGrpCat.free)))
    (ha : (∀ (U : Opens X) (h : U ⟶ (⊤ : Opens X)),
        a.hom.app (op U)
          ((toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
            (yoneda.obj (⊤ : Opens X) ⋙ AddCommGrpCat.free)).app
              (op U) (FreeAbelianGroup.of h)) =
          (toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology Z)
            (yoneda.obj (⊤ : Opens Z) ⋙ AddCommGrpCat.free)).app
              (op ((Opens.map f).obj U))
              (FreeAbelianGroup.of ((Opens.map f).map h ≫
                eqToHom (Opens.map_top f)))))
 :
    ∃ E : E₂CohomologicalSpectralSequenceNat
        (Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology Z) AddCommGrpCat.{u} ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u}),
      ∃ e₂ : ∀ a b : ℕ, (E.page 2).X (a, b) ≅
          (TopCat.Sheaf.pushforwardAb f).rightDerived b ⋙ HX a,
        (∀ a b : ℕ, ∃ (R : ℤ) (_hR : 2 ≤ R), ∀ (r : ℤ) (hr : R ≤ r),
          Nonempty ((E.page r (by omega)).X (a, b) ≅ E.pageInfinity (a, b))) ∧
        ∃ T : ∀ n : ℕ, DecreasingFiltration (HZ n),
          (∀ n, (T n).step 0 = ⊤) ∧
          (∀ n, (T n).step (n + 1) = ⊥) ∧
          ∃ g : ∀ p q : ℕ, (T (p + q)).gradedPiece p ≅ E.pageInfinity (p, q),
            ∃ e₀ : ∀ p : ℕ,
                TopCat.Sheaf.pushforwardAb f ⋙ HX p ≅ (E.page 2).X (p, 0),
              (∀ p, (e₀ p).hom =
                Functor.whiskerRight (TopCat.Sheaf.pushforwardAb f).toRightDerivedZero
                  (HX p) ≫ (e₂ p 0).inv) ∧
              ∃ t : ∀ (p : ℕ) (r : ℤ) (hr : 2 ≤ r),
                  (E.page r hr).X (p, 0) ⟶ (E.page (r + 1) (by omega)).X (p, 0),
                (∀ (p : ℕ) (r : ℤ) (hr : 2 ≤ r),
                  (E.page r hr).iCycles (p, 0) ≫ t p r hr =
                    (E.page r hr).homologyπ (p, 0) ≫ (E.iso r (r + 1) (p, 0) rfl hr).hom) ∧
                ∃ b : ∀ (p : ℕ) (r : ℤ) (hr : 2 ≤ r),
                    (E.page 2).X (p, 0) ⟶ (E.page r hr).X (p, 0),
                  (∀ p, b p 2 (by omega) = 𝟙 _) ∧
                  (∀ (p : ℕ) (r : ℤ) (hr : 2 ≤ r),
                    b p (r + 1) (by omega) = b p r hr ≫ t p r hr) ∧
                  ∃ k : ∀ p : ℕ, E.pageInfinity (p, 0) ≅ ((T p).step p :
                      Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology Z) AddCommGrpCat.{u} ⥤
                        AddCommGrpCat.{u}),
                    (∀ p, cokernel.π (Subobject.ofLE ((T p).step (p + 1))
                      ((T p).step p) ((T p).antitone_step (by omega))) ≫
                        (g p 0).hom = (k p).inv) ∧
                    ∃ bottom : ∀ p : ℕ, TopCat.Sheaf.pushforwardAb f ⋙ HX p ⟶ HZ p,
                      (∀ p, bottom p = (e₀ p).hom ≫ b p (p + 2) (by omega) ≫
                        (k p).hom ≫ ((T p).step p).arrow) ∧
                    (∀ (F : Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology Z) AddCommGrpCat.{u})
        (I : InjectiveResolution F)
        (J : InjectiveResolution ((TopCat.Sheaf.pushforwardAb f).obj F))
        (φ : J.cocomplex ⟶
          ((TopCat.Sheaf.pushforwardAb f).mapHomologicalComplex
            (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj I.cocomplex)
        (_hφ : J.ι.f 0 ≫ φ.f 0 =
          (TopCat.Sheaf.pushforwardAb f).map (I.ι.f 0)) (p : ℕ)
        (s : (presheafToSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
          AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
          (yoneda.obj (⊤ : Opens X) ⋙ AddCommGrpCat.free) ⟶
            J.cocomplex.X p)
        (hs : s ≫ J.cocomplex.d p (p + 1) = 0)
        (z : (presheafToSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology Z)
          AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
          (yoneda.obj (⊤ : Opens Z) ⋙ AddCommGrpCat.free) ⟶
            I.cocomplex.X p)
        (hz : z ≫ I.cocomplex.d p (p + 1) = 0)
        (_hsz : a ≫ (TopCat.Sheaf.pushforwardAb f).map z = s ≫ φ.f p),
        (eqToHom (congrArg (fun Q ↦ Q.obj F) (hZ p)))
          ((bottom p).app F
            ((eqToHom (congrArg (fun Q ↦ Q.obj
              ((TopCat.Sheaf.pushforwardAb f).obj F)) (hX p)).symm)
              (J.extMk s (p + 1) rfl hs))) =
            I.extMk z (p + 1) rfl hz)
